info.name: Curio
info.summary: Curate images, links, videos and notes into visual boards, right inside Nextcloud.
info.description:
Curio turns the images, links, videos and notes you collect into visual boards you can filter, tag and share. Paste a link from Pinterest, Instagram, YouTube or any website and it pulls in the picture, title and a snapshot for you. Upload your own photos, drop in a PDF, or jot a quick note. Everything lands on a board as a tidy, browsable tile.
## Bring everything together
Add references from wherever you find them:
- Photos and images uploaded straight from your device - Links from Pinterest, Instagram, YouTube and any website, with the image, title and a saved snapshot grabbed automatically - Videos, either embedded from a provider or uploaded directly - PDFs, shown with a page preview - Plain text notes for the ideas that do not have a link yet
When a page offers more than one image, you choose which one becomes the tile.
## Organize the way you think
Sort references into boards, one per project, mood or topic. Tag them with colored labels and group those labels into folders, so a growing collection stays easy to navigate. Filter a board by type or by tag to narrow thousands of references down to the handful you need right now. Hashtags you write in a title or note are matched to your tags automatically.
## See your references your way
Switch between layouts to suit the work. The vertical masonry view tiles everything by its natural shape, so a board reads like a moodboard rather than a spreadsheet. A jump index lets you move through a long board quickly without losing your place.
## Collaborate
Share a board with anyone on your Nextcloud, with view-only or full edit access. Sharing uses Nextcloud's own sharing and permissions, so collaborators' changes are attributed to them and your server stays in control. Leave comments on a reference to discuss it in context.
## Your data stays yours
On first launch you choose the Nextcloud folder where Curio keeps its boards. Every reference becomes a real file in your Nextcloud Files, kept in a folder for its board. Drop a file into that folder and it appears on the board; rename or remove it and the board follows. Export or import a board as CSV whenever you like. Nothing is sent to a third party. Your references live on your server, under your control.
